description: Fork of exp593 (1.4337 SoTA, read_out NAP=5). SINGLE change: out_proj NAP 6 -> 5 (K=64 -> 32). Atoms/layer 65K -> 32K, params/layer 25.17M -> 12.58M, total out_proj 150.99M -> 75.50M (-75.50M, -29% of model). Per-token bandwidth UNCHANGED (NAP cuts weight storage only). Same gradient-coverage hypothesis as exp593: doubles tokens/row from 128 -> 256 at bs=16, expected to help cleaner Lion sign updates especially late-phase. Tests whether the NAP=5 gradient-coverage finding generalizes from read_out to out_proj. Total ~185.6M params, 155 Mbits trunk (unchanged), 558 Mbits total (unchanged).
